[[Fresno, California]] | college = [[Stanford University|Stanford]] | draft = | draft_year = | draft_team = | former_teams = | awards = }} '''Robin Byron Lopez''' (born [[April 1]], [[1988]] in [[North Hollywood, California|North Hollywood]], [[California]]) is a 7'0" [[United States|American]] [[college basketball|basketball]] player who played for the [[Stanford Cardinal]] in the [[Pacific Ten|Pacific-Ten Conference]] of the [[National Collegiate Athletic Association|NCAA]]. He is the identical twin brother of current teammate [[Brook Lopez]]. ==Biography== Robin Lopez was born in Panorama City, California on April 1, 1988 to Deborah Ledford and his now estranged father Heriberto Lopez, a native of [[Cuba]]. He was born into a life of basketball and art, as his grandfather played at the [[University of Colorado at Boulder|University of Colorado]] and his aunt was an architect residing in the Bay Area. Lopez moved from [[Hollywood, California]] to [[Oak Harbor, Washington]] while in second grade to be near his older brother, Alex, who was playing basketball at the [[University of Washington|University of Washington]] at the time. He moved to his current hometown of [[Fresno, California]] a year later, where he attended San Joaquin Memorial High School. There, he played with his twin brother [[Brook Lopez|Brook Lopez]], as well as current [[University of Washington|Washington]] standout Quincy Pondexter. Both teammates played with Lopez on their successful AAU team, the Elite Basketball Organization (EBO), along with Derrick Jasper of the [[University of Kentucky|University of Kentucky]] and Trevo'nn Willis of the [[University of Nevada, Las Vegas|University of Nevada, Las Vegas]]. Lopez was named MVP of the Adidas Superstar Camp Underclass All-Star game his junior year and to both the 2006 McDonald's All American team and the Parade All-American team his senior year. Lopez declared that he would enter the NBA draft on March 31, 2008, after just two seasons at Stanford.[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2008/news/story?id=3322897 Robin, Brook to enter NBA draft after two seasons at Stanford] ==College career== Lopez was one of just three players for the Cardinal team to start all 31 games in the 2006-2007 season. He averaged 7.5 [[Point (basketball)|points]] and 5.5 [[Rebound (basketball)|rebounds]] per game, while averaging 24 minutes.[http://gostanford.cstv.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/lopez_robin00.html Robin Lopez's Stanford Player Bio]. He led the team with 73 [[Block (basketball)|blocked shots]], breaking the Stanford record for a freshman and recording the second highest single season record in Stanford history. This mark also was the highest in the entire Pacific 10 conference. With his twin brother, [[Brook Lopez|Brook]], the two blocked more shots than seven Pac-10 teams.[http://www.pac-10.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/041007aab.html 2006-2007 Pac-10 Men's Basketball Wrap-Up] Lopez also had two [[Double-double|double-doubles]] on the season. Lopez had his 100th career [[Block (basketball)|block]] in a game versus Santa Clara University on December 19, 2007. In his sophomore season, Lopez achieved All Pac-10 Defensive Team honors while also being named an Honorable Mention to the All Pac-10 team.[http://www.pac-10.org/sports/m-baskbl/spec-rel/032608aaa.html Stanford Battles Texas Friday In NCAA Tournament Sweet 16] He was second in the Pac-10 in blocks for the season. With 83 blocks in his second season, Lopez moved into second place all time for career blocks by a Stanford player. ==Career Statistics== ====Season Averages==== {| class="wikitable" |- ! Year !
